```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The U.S. Forest Service controls around 200 million acres of land with natural resources, especially timber, a renewable resource providing jobs for thousands of workers.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Many national forests are in worsening health with the threat of invasive species, insect mortality, and the severe risk of wildfire.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The increase in catastrophic wildfires has been needlessly killing millions of animals and destroying homes and watersheds for decades in the western states.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The expense to suppress wildfires related to failed federal forest policies continues to increase.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"When timber is managed properly, renewable crops will result in fewer wildfires and produce jobs in the timber industry for countless families.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for promoting active, sustainable management of forests.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Belief that states can best manage forests to improve forest health and keep communities safe.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The United States has greater energy resources than any other place on earth.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Engineers and miners in the United States are the best in the world.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The work of people in America's energy sector can guarantee the nation's energy security for centuries to come.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Support for government facilitating the creation of an all-of-the-above energy strategy.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```

```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The U.S. Forest Service, within the Department of Agriculture, controls around 200 million acres of land with enormous natural resources, especially timber, a renewable resource providing jobs for thousands of workers that should be used to the best economic potential for the nation.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Many of our national forests are in worsening health with the threat of invasive species, insect mortality, and the severe risk of wildfire.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The increase in catastrophic wildfires has been needlessly killing millions of animals and destroying homes and watersheds for decades in the western states.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The expense to suppress wildfires related to failed federal forest policies continues to increase.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"When timber is managed properly, the renewable crops will result in fewer wildfires and, at the same time, produce jobs in the timber industry for countless families.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for promoting active, sustainable management of our forests.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Belief that states can best manage our forests to improve forest health and keep communities safe.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The United States has greater energy resources than any other place on earth.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Engineers and miners in the United States are the best in the world.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The work of people in America's energy sector can guarantee the nation's energy security for centuries to come if, instead of erecting roadblocks, government facilitates the creation of an all-of-the-above energy strategy.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Support for government facilitating the creation of an all-of-the-above energy strategy.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
